title: AnalystArtifact
description: Structured output of the Analyst Agent, built entirely from research_evidence.schema.json records. Consumed by the Strategy Agent and, eventually, the Docs Writer. Every factual field is either grounded in evidence_ids, explicitly marked as taken directly from PROJECT_BRIEF.md, or explicitly marked as analyst inference -- never left ambiguous.

EvidenceIdRef.description: Must reference an evidence_id that exists in the current run's evidence set (research_evidence.schema.json).

CompetitorName.description: Fixed, exact-string set matching PROJECT_BRIEF.md's candidate competitor list plus Wire3 itself. Locked as an enum so implementations can't diverge on naming/casing (e.g. 'AT&T' vs 'ATT' vs 'AT and T').

value.description: The typed value. Expected type is given in the description of the property that uses this $def (this schema keeps it untyped here because JSON Schema has no generics).

evidence_ids.description: Evidence backing this value. Required non-empty when basis = 'evidence'. May be empty when basis = 'brief_stated' or 'inference'.

basis.description: 'evidence' = grounded in >=1 research evidence records (evidence_ids must be non-empty). 'brief_stated' = taken directly from PROJECT_BRIEF.md as a given input (e.g. 'Wire3 has no mobile bundle'), not from external research. 'inference' = the Analyst Agent's own reasoning/judgment; evidence_ids may be empty but should still be populated if the inference was prompted by specific evidence.

DerivedField.description: For values the Analyst Agent computes rather than reads directly from a source (e.g. a blended effective price). Never use CitedField for a computed number -- the computation itself is not a citable fact.

formula.description: Must restate the fixed formula used, so n8n and CrewAI compute identical numbers from identical inputs rather than each inventing their own rounding/weighting logic.

footprint_confirmed_in_region.description: value: boolean -- confirmed serviceable in Ocala/Marion County specifically (RQ1), not statewide/national footprint.

has_mobile_bundle_available.description: value: boolean. For the Wire3 row this must be basis='brief_stated' (false, per the brief), never 'evidence'.

summary_note.description: Optional. value: short free-text string, basis may be 'inference'.

promo_status.description: value: one of 'has_promo' | 'no_promo_found' | 'not_researched'. 'no_promo_found' is itself a claim (an absence) and must carry basis='evidence' with the evidence_id of the page checked, or basis='inference' only if genuinely unresearched is not the case -- 'not_researched' is the only status allowed to have empty evidence_ids.

promo_price_usd_per_month.description: value: number, in USD, 2 decimals, or null when promo_status != 'has_promo'. Never a formatted string like '$49.99'.

promo_duration_months.description: value: integer months, or null when promo_status != 'has_promo'.

blended_12mo_effective_price_usd.description: Fixed formula: ((promo_price * promo_duration_months) + (post_promo_price * (12 - promo_duration_months))) / 12. When promo_status != 'has_promo', use promo_duration_months = 0 and promo_price = post_promo_price.

ProductFeatureRow.description: Fixed core column set (controlled vocabulary) so row shape can't drift between implementations based on whatever the Research Agent happened to discover. Anything beyond this core set goes in additional_features, not new top-level keys.

additional_features.description: Open-ended extension bucket for anything discovered beyond the fixed core columns above. Keeps optional findings from corrupting the comparable core schema.

description.description: Prose synthesis across multiple evidence records. Citation granularity here is deliberately theme-level (one evidence_ids list for the whole theme), not sentence-level like the tables above.

basis.description: Same three-way split as CitedField.basis. Prevents fabricated citations for structural facts (e.g. 'no mobile bundle' is 'brief_stated') and prevents silently uncited items that should be inference-flagged.

market_description.description: value: string. Describes how the CURRENT competitive market behaves on this P (e.g. for 'promotion': 'all three incumbents rely on 12-month promo-rate discounts'). This is descriptive/analytical, not prescriptive -- Wire3's own positioning/strategy recommendation belongs in the Strategy Agent's artifact, not here.

wire3_relevant_fact.description: Optional. value: string. A Wire3-specific fact relevant to this P, sourced only from Wire3's public site (basis='evidence') or the brief (basis='brief_stated'). Never a strategic recommendation.

brief_id.description: Ties this artifact back to the PROJECT_BRIEF.md version it was built from.

competitor_comparison_table.description: Exactly one row per entry in CompetitorName's enum (Wire3 + the 3 candidate competitors), no more, no fewer.

pricing_matrix.description: One or more rows per competitor (multiple speed tiers allowed); at least one row per CompetitorName.

product_feature_comparison.description: Exactly one row per CompetitorName, same fixed set as competitor_comparison_table.

seven_p_analysis.description: Fixed as 7P (not 4P) and represented as an object keyed by category, not an array -- guarantees exactly one entry per category with no duplicates or missing categories, and removes the '4P or 7P' choice as a source of divergence between implementations.
